name: antigravity-token-telemetry
description: Displays live Antigravity model, context tokens, turn delta, latency (TTFT), and KV cache hits in the native VS Code Status Bar.

antigravity.statusBar.alignment.description: Alignment of the Antigravity telemetry item in the status bar.

antigravity.statusBar.priority.description: Priority order of the status bar item.

antigravity.statusBar.fallbackToGlobal.description: Fall back to global Antigravity telemetry (~/.gemini/antigravity/telemetry) if no workspace file is found.

antigravity.statusBar.enableHealthColors.description: Color status bar item with warning (yellow) or error (red) semaphore highlights when thresholds are breached.

antigravity.statusBar.enableCriticalAler.description: Show a brief recommended action popup when any situation suggests starting a new chat or optimizing agent/skills files.

antigravity.statusBar.warningThreshold.description: Tokens Warning Threshold (yellow indicator): Context token count above which session is considered heavy.

antigravity.statusBar.criticalThreshold.description: Tokens Critical Threshold (red indicator): Context token count above which starting a new chat is recommended.

antigravity.statusBar.cacheWarningThresh.description: KV Cache Hit % Warning Threshold (yellow indicator): Cache percentage below which reuse is suboptimal.

antigravity.statusBar.cacheCriticalThres.description: KV Cache Hit % Critical Threshold (red indicator): Cache percentage below which prefix invalidation is flagged.

antigravity.statusBar.ttftWarningThresho.description: TTFT Latency Warning Threshold (seconds, yellow indicator): Latency above which response is considered elevated.

antigravity.statusBar.ttftCriticalThresh.description: TTFT Latency Critical Threshold (seconds, red indicator): Latency above which response is considered stalling.
